title: Compute raw ab initio enthalpies of formation
action: Using the provided electronic energies, vibrational frequencies, and atomization enthalpies of elements, compute the standard enthalpies of formation (Δ_fH°) at 298 K for each molecule (ethane and nine fluoroethanes) and each method (G2(MP2), G2, CBS-4, CBS-Q) via an atomization-based thermochemical cycle. Incorporate zero-point energy and thermal corrections according to standard procedure.
description: Intermediate step that produces the uncorrected ab initio enthalpies of formation. These are required to compute deviations and apply the bond additivity correction in the next step.

title: Apply C–F bond additivity correction and evaluate residual errors
action: Read the raw enthalpies, experimental enthalpies, and the provided Δ_C-F parameters. For each fluoroethane and ethane, compute the deviation of the raw enthalpy from experiment, then apply the C–F bond additivity correction (Δ_BAC = n_CF × Δ_C-F). Compute the BAC-corrected enthalpy and its deviation from experiment. Save all quantities to a CSV file.
description: Final scored artifact containing the raw and BAC-corrected enthalpies of formation and their deviations from experiment for all four methods and all ten molecules. The checker derives the per-method residual average error (AVE2) for fluoroethanes from this file and compares against the hidden gold reference.
output_schema: CSV with columns: method (string), molecule (string), n_CF (int), calc_Hf_abinitio (numeric, kJ mol⁻¹), dev_abinitio (numeric, kJ mol⁻¹), calc_Hf_BAC (numeric, kJ mol⁻¹), dev_BAC (numeric, kJ mol⁻¹).
